item.title: Today in History: January 29, Bush warns of ‘axis of evil’
item.description: President George W. Bush said terrorists were still threatening America — and warned of “an axis of evil” consisting of North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

item.title: ‘An invitation to reconnect’
item.description: Di Micele – with her five-octave voice – will perform Feb. 5 at 7 p.m. at the Arcata Playhouse, 1251 Ninth St., Arcata, and Feb. 6 at 7 p.m. at the Redwood Playhouse in Garberville.

item.title: Candidates sought for local Dairy Princess contest
item.description: California Dairy Princesses support the reputation of milk and dairy products through appearances at schools, fairs, industry meetings, service clubs and parades.

item.title: Chowder champions
item.description: Winners in the professional category were first place, Diver Bar and Grill, and second place, Uniquely Yours Catering.

item.title: Soroptimists honor ‘Girls of the Month’
item.description: At its January meeting, Soroptimist International of Arcata honored “Girls of the Month” Jaz Goodwin, Kiera McWilliams, Myrsadies Hufford and Lucy Dieker. They were recognized for school participation, community service and academic excellence.

item.title: ‘Vagina Monologues’ marks 25th anniversary of first local production
item.description: “I didn’t want to revisit this play out of nostalgia. I wanted to return because the questions it asks —about safety, sexuality and voice — haven’t gone away. They’ve just shifted,” Hellum said.

item.title: North Coast Gardening | Fun projects abound in the winter garden
item.description: Take a trip to the nursery and discover the plethora of primulas blooming cheerfully as if winter never existed.

item.title: Unmentioned but present, Trump is a common denominator in efforts to strengthen Asia-Europe ties
item.description: Trump's shaking up of the global order is worrying friends and foes and driving them closer.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.
